steps.label: Cross-validate
steps.sub: One small test set can mislead

code:
texts = [t for t, _ in tickets]
labels = [l for _, l in tickets]
X_tr, X_te, y_tr, y_te = train_test_split(
    texts, labels, test_size=0.25,
    stratify=labels, random_state=42)
model = make_pipeline(TfidfVectorizer(),
    LogisticRegression(max_iter=1000))
model.fit(X_tr, y_tr)
caption: The pipeline refits the vectorizer on training data only.

model.score(X_te, y_te)      # 0.667

code:
cv = StratifiedKFold(5, shuffle=True,
                     random_state=42)
cross_val_score(model, texts, labels, cv=cv)

# [0.75 0.83 0.83 0.67 0.83]  mean 0.78
# stop_words="english"         mean 0.70
# C=10                         mean 0.80
caption: Folds range from 0.67 to 0.83. Small data, wide spread.

code:
fn = model[0].get_feature_names_out()
coef = model[1].coef_
fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 3, figsize=(11, 4))
for i, ax in enumerate(axes):
    top = np.argsort(coef[i])[-6:]
    ax.barh(fn[top], coef[i][top])
    ax.set_title(model.classes_[i])
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig("top_words.png", dpi=150)
caption: Top six words by coefficient, for each class.
